hero.title: Undergraduate Computer Engineering in Sweden for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: Study innovative Computer and Electronics Engineering in Sweden at globally ranked institutes of technology like KTH and Chalmers, mastering embedded systems, telecommunications hardware, and post-study residence permits.

overview: Sweden is a renowned global leader in telecommunications infrastructure, automotive electronics, and sustainable hardware engineering, home to technological pioneers like Ericsson, Volvo, and ABB. Studying undergraduate Computer Engineering in Sweden offers Indian students an egalitarian, innovation-driven learning environment focused on open-source hardware, embedded computing, and digital systems resilience.

Swedish technical universities offer English-taught 3-year Bachelor of Science programs (180 ECTS) in Information and Communication Technology and Computer Hardware Systems. The academic curriculum combines digital electronics, microprocessor design, real-time operating systems, wireless communication hardware, and embedded programming, supported by state-of-the-art campus cleanrooms and corporate-sponsored design labs.

Under Swedish Migration Agency (Migrationsverket) regulations, international graduates completing an accredited Bachelor's degree in Sweden can apply for a post-study residence permit for up to 12 months to seek employment or explore business startup opportunities, provided they satisfy self-sufficiency maintenance funds (SEK 10,656/month for applications submitted in 2026) and comprehensive health insurance requirements, establishing direct routes into Sweden's advanced electronics and telecommunications industries.

items: 8. Computer Engineering Certification and Higher Education in Sweden
In Sweden there is no single professional license for computer engineering. Employers may expect specific technical skills, recognized qualifications or relevant certifications.
Technical Knowledge
Students can supplement their profiles by learning programming, computer architecture, digital electronics, networking, embedded systems and software development.
Professional Certifications
Students may pursue additional certifications as they pursue career interests:
Cloud computing & infrastructure.
Network security and networking.
Cyber Security.
Software development
Artificial intelligence and data analytics.
Management of Projects.
Many roles do not need these certifications and they do not substitute for a university degree where one is required.
Continuing Education

After earning a bachelor’s degree, graduates may go on to earn a master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, embedded systems, communication systems, artificial intelligence or cybersecurity. Admission is based on the prerequisites of the program and the student’s academic background.
9. Salary and Job Opportunities for Bachelor's in Computer Engineering in Sweden

Graduates can find jobs in software, electronics, telecommunications, embedded systems, automotive technology and other industries that depend on computing infrastructure. Students pursuing Computer Engineering in Sweden for Indian Students can explore different career paths depending on their specialization, technical skills and experience.
Career opportunities may include:
Computer Engineer: Works with computer systems, hardware, software integration and technical solutions.
Software Developer: Designs, creates, tests and maintains software applications.
Embedded Systems Engineer: Integrates software and hardware into smart devices and industrial equipment.
Network Engineer: Supports computer networks and connectivity and communication infrastructure.
Systems Engineer: Assists in the design, integration and maintenance of complex technical systems.
Cybersecurity Analyst: Helps identify vulnerabilities and protect computer systems and electronic information.
Hardware Design Engineer: Works on digital circuits, electronic components, and computer hardware, depending on the role’s requirements.
IT Support or Systems Specialist: Provide help to maintain IT systems, offer troubleshooting and user support.
AI or Data Engineering Professional: This could be a possibility after learning the necessary skills in programming, mathematics and data.
Salary Expectations

Salaries are influenced by experience, specialization, employer, location and technical skills. The entry level ones tend to be paid less than the experienced engineers and the specialized professionals.

Students are encouraged to check current salary statistics and job advertisements for the specific position they want to pursue. A bachelor’s degree does not guaranty a certain salary or a job straight away.
International graduates should also be aware of the language requirements of the employer and the immigration rules that apply when planning to work in Sweden.
10. Documents Required to Pursue BSc in Computer Engineering in Sweden
Please refer to the official admissions checklist and prepare the required documents accordingly. These can include:
Valid passport or recognized identification.
Class 10 mark sheet and certificate (when required).
Class 12 certificate & marksheet.
Proof of mathematical and physical qualifications.
Proof of English Proficiency (if required)
Official translations of documents when required.
Additional program-specific documents.
Proof of payment of application fee (if applicable).
Admission documents and financial documents for residence permit procedures, if applicable.

Ensure that all academic transcripts are complete, legible and submitted by the stated deadline. Depending on the applicant’s country of education and the university you have chosen, the requirements may differ.
11. Common Questions for Bachelor’s in Computer Engineering in Sweden
1. Can I Study Computer Engineering in Sweden After 12th For Indian Students?

Yes. The school qualifications must meet the general admission requirements and the Indian students must meet the specific requirements in mathematics, physics and language. Edu-Hawk Worldwide can guide students through the study-abroad application process and help them understand the admission steps.
2. Are there computer engineering bachelor programs taught in English in Sweden?

There aren't many options to study in English. Information and communication technology. This is a three-year bachelor’s program from KTH in English. It covers computing, electronics, programming and communication technology.
3. How long does a bachelor in Computer Engineering take in Sweden?
Most of the bachelor’s programs last for three years and are worth 180 ECTS credits. Length and degree title differ depending on the program chosen.
4. What is the fee of studying computer engineering in Sweden in Indian rupees?

As a rough estimate, annual tuition fees could be in the range of ₹9.61 lakh to ₹16.34 lakh and annual living expenses around ₹10.38 lakh to ₹15 lakh. The actual cost will depend on the university, the course, the city and also the exchange rate.
5. What kind of jobs can I get in Sweden after a bachelor's in computer engineering?

Graduates may seek positions in software development, computer systems, embedded technology, networking, hardware, cybersecurity and other information technology fields. The career options available depend on technical skills, experience, requirements of the employer and applicable work authorization.
